scope: Queue-group study fragment; candidate generation and explicit visual reuse only, never full-catalog completion or asset approval.

entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Diablo 3D candidate object-modeling reference.
Input image 1 is a PRIVATE original inventory sprite, used only to preserve recognizable silhouette, colors, material regions and distinctive details. Create NEW HD imagery throughout; never paste the sprite into any view or thumbnail.
A clean technical board of the exact SAME single object in FRONT, SIDE, BACK, THREE-QUARTER and a small NEW HD INVENTORY thumbnail. All views must agree on geometry, proportions, material layout and distinctive details; back is the true reverse, not another front. Full object visible, generously spaced, plain charcoal-gray backdrop, neutral soft studio lighting, no colored illumination or glow, realistic restrained dark medieval materials and fine wear. No scene, body, face, hands, stand, exploded alternatives or extra props. Rear/hidden surfaces and absolute scale are proposed reconstruction; preserve visible source design. Thumbnail must be a new high-detail render of this same object, never pixel-art or the supplied sprite. Minimal labels: item name, FRONT, SIDE, BACK, 3/4, ICON.
Subject: Staff of Lazarus; item.design.base.staff-of-lazarus; native cursor 155.
One tall slender ceremonial staff from the reference, gold/brass-brown shaft with FOUR small pale silver-gray skull ornaments spaced down its upper-to-middle shaft. Preserve a gold forked/clawed crown at the top: a long upswept left prong, a lower outward swept right prong, and a central support holding a large deep red faceted gemstone. The staff's visible shaft is long and narrow with modest gold base tip; no broad blade, axe, spear, fire, glow or aura. Skull ornaments are stylized carved metal details, no gore, no attached body. Infer rear attachments for the same four skulls, do not multiply or remove them between views. Gem stays one dark ruby red jewel in the same claw crown.

reference.notes: Licensed original inventory sprite inspected privately at nearest-neighbor 6x enlargement; no original pixels or file paths are included.

inferredParts: Fine construction/material details unresolved by source pixels
entries.nativeIdentityPolicy: Visual study only. Native item identities, unique powers, stats, affixes, saves and RNG are separate and unchanged.
entries.identityGate: Candidate design requires visual review and multiview reconciliation. Confirm the five native skull forms and crown/shaft proportions before master production; do not derive ornament count from the inaccurate four-count in the preserved generation prompt.
entries.notes: Reference sheet shows five pale skull ornaments matching the five visible pale forms in the source sprite. The generation prompt's four-count was inaccurate and is preserved verbatim for provenance; the generated output retains five consistently. Neutral-light candidate only; all hidden attachments, absolute scale and construction detail remain inferred. New HD thumbnail is not a runtime icon.

Subject: Tavern Sign; item.design.base.tavern-sign; native cursor 126.
The full object is the entire medieval tavern sign assembly seen in the source: a slender vertical dark weathered wooden post at left, a single thick horizontal timber crossarm extending to right near the top, TWO short gray iron chain hangers, and one small brown shield-shaped hanging sign panel below. The panel has angled upper shoulders and a rounded pointed lower tip. Its front carries a single large muted warm golden sunburst/diamond-shaped glowing-looking emblem, rendered as aged pale yellow paint/metal under neutral light without emission. Preserve the reference's post, beam, chain count, sign silhouette and emblem placement. No readable text, beer mug, tavern building, base platform, scenery, wall, extra hooks or modern graphic. Back is inferred plain dark timber with small chain fittings, reverse of same assembly, not another front.
